title: 출국대기실 운영 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01038:20221205:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on Protection of Foreigners) <No. 1038, December 5, 2022>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force three months after the date of their promulgation.
Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes) Part of the Rules on Operation of Departure Waiting Rooms shall be amended as follows:
In the former part of Article 9, "Article 43" shall be replaced with "Article 43 and Articles 43-2 through 43-6," and in the latter part of the same Article, the relevant cross-references shall be amended as prescribed.
